evidence: Modifies parameter parsing in wallet RPCs (src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp, src/wallet/rpc/wallet.cpp, src/wallet/rpc/util.cpp).
rationale: Starts the deprecation process for dead watch-only parameters in wallet RPCs. While it cleans up interface cruft and alerts users that options like includeWatching are no-ops, it does not impact core wallet fund safety, keys, or transaction construction.
